scientific_integrity: The DGZ normalization, automorphism group, genus, and short-orbit classification are previously established theorems. The new assertion is precisely the degree-seven vanishing for six finite fields, with a coprime-Frobenius orbit argument and exact Hasse–Weil inequalities. The separate finite-field program is corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: This is a six-field vanishing result, not a complete zeta function or an assertion for all finite fields.
The argument is conditional only on established geometric facts from the cited primary papers; no independent external mathematical audit was conducted.
Equivalent degree-seven vanishing statements may exist in unindexed literature; absence from searches is not certification of priority.
title: No degree-seven points on six Dickson–Guralnick–Zieve curves
